text:
olivia_support: :rotating_light: FYI - multiple customers reporting 504/timeouts from hosted inference in eu-central-1b since ~08:12 UTC. Symptoms: long tail latency, repeated auth retries, some requests charged twice. Escalating to infra. @junaid_net can you eyeball network?

maria_ops: seeing spike in gateway 504s and gateway error rate from eu-central-1b. Alerts show 3x normal egress retransmits and a rise in connection resets.

junaid_net: I see an AS path change to one of our transit providers around 08:11:23 UTC. Partial withdraws to nexthop causing asymmetric routing into eu-central-1b. BGP session flapped with provider-P.

junaid_net: quick traceroute from a gateway host (sanitized):
```
traceroute to 10.2.3.4 (10.2.3.4), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.1.1  0.45 ms  0.35 ms  0.34 ms
 2  100.64.5.1  1.2 ms  1.1 ms  1.0 ms
 3  * * *
 4  provider-P-ix  45.2 ms  46.0 ms  44.8 ms
 5  provider-P-peering  120.4 ms  138.2 ms  122.1 ms
 6  eu-central-1b-edge  142.6 ms  140.9 ms  201.1 ms
```
Note the jump and intermittent * hops, consistent with microbursts/reorders.

ida_sre: packet capture from front-gateway shows bursts of dup acks and retransmits during 08:11-08:20 window. KV cache hit rate dropped ~25% which is amplifying latency.

sam_infra: mitigation steps taken: enabled regional failover to eu-central-1a for control plane and model traffic for affected customer buckets; scaled up dedicated front gateways in 1a. Canary for ACCT-8342 shows reduced 504s from 18% -> 3% after 08:28.

customer_acct_rep: ACCT-8342 confirms improvement but asking why they were billed for multiple retries — can we confirm whether retries were client-side or server-side? They want credit for duplicate charges.

olivia_support: capture of a failed request (curl) from a customer:
```
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.example
> Authorization: Bearer ********
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
< x-request-id: r-xyz-123
< content-type: application/json
{ "error": "gateway_timeout", "message": "upstream hang after 30s" }
```
Looks like the gateway timed out waiting on backend compute due to higher tail latency.

junaid_net: provider-P confirms they saw transient upstream hardware overload and a partial path withdraw; they pushed a prepended path to prefer alternate POPs and we're seeing improved convergence. They estimate root fix in 2-3 hours (hardware replacement).

maria_ops: short-term actions: 1) keep failover to 1a for affected routes, 2) raise per-customer fallback policies so heavy requests fall back to lower-latency model variant when gateway SLO degraded, 3) temporarily raise circuit read timeout to avoid double-billing client retries. Can we coordinate billing/CS?

ida_sre: logging note - add alert for KV cache miss spike and cross-AZ retransmit rate > 5% as an early warning. Also we'll add residual-rate limiter threshold to reduce duplicate processing on retries.

sam_infra: applied a transient routing policy to prefer provider-Q for eu-central-1b egress. System canary looks stable for 10 minutes. Reverting scaling after stabilization.

customer_acct_rep: filed a refund request for ACCT-8342 and notified legal/finance. Sent customers a note that we're investigating and applied temporary credits pending postmortem. They asked for ETA on full incident summary.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-6842, severity P1. Assigned to ida_sre and junaid_net for postmortem.

olivia_support: next steps — keep channel updated with any regression. If provider reports any further BGP withdraws ping here. We'll assemble timeline + repro steps for PM.

ida_sre: repro notes to include in postmortem: list of customer request IDs, sample curl responses (504), traceroute output, pcap snippet showing dup-acks, BGP withdraw timestamps from provider, KV cache miss metrics, and billing events tied to request IDs.

maria_ops: tagging for tracking: #network, #billing, #cust-svcs. Closing immediate mitigation but leaving P1 until provider root cause resolved.

olivia_support: :white_check_mark: Thanks all — will prep customer-facing summary once we have the postmortem draft.
